integrity: All mathematics and reproducibility code is included; direct finite tests support but do not replace the proof. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, exactly two sequential length-two palindromic duplications, n >= 4; no claim for other duplication counts/lengths, nonbinary alphabets, or coding capacity. Earlier maximum and conjugacy credited. An unindexed equivalent could exist.
title: The sharp three-descendant stability gap for binary two-step length-two palindromic duplication
